stories.title: Petitions against Saltney and Mold school closure plans to be handed to Flintshire Council this week
stories.summary: Petitions from parents, pupils and staff opposed to plans to close two primary schools will be handed over to Flintshire County Council this week. stories.title: Luxury bridal room and outdoor wedding service area added to Soughton Hall plans
stories.summary: Plans for a permanent new wedding venue at historic Soughton Hall have been updated to include an outdoor wedding venue space and more luxurious bridal room. stories.title: HMRC reminds millions of Self Assessment taxpayers of 31 July payment deadline
stories.summary: Millions of Self Assessment taxpayers have one month to prepare for a payment deadline, HM Revenue and Customs has warned. stories.summary: Flintshire has half the number of full-size 3G football pitches it needs for its current player base, according to a new plan that identifies three priority sites for new pitches at Deeside Leisure Centre, Hawarden High School and St David’s High School in Saltney. stories.title: Motorcyclist stopped at 96mph on return trip to Wirral from north Wales found with illegal tyre
stories.summary: A motorcyclist travelling at 96mph on a return journey to the Wirral from north Wales has been stopped by North Wales Police roads officers and found to be riding on an illegal rear tyre, with a pillion passenger on board. Officers on Operation Apex patrols made the stop. The rider was issued a Traffic Offence
